name: Zoar
line: Zoar was a small city near Sodom, also called Bela, that God spared from destruction so Lot had a safe place to run.

moments.title: A Town Spared for Lot
moments.text: Lot asks to flee to a small nearby town, and he is told it will not be destroyed. It is called Zoar, and Lot had reached it by the time the sun had risen.

moments.title: Lot Leaves Zoar
moments.text: After Sodom and Gomorrah are destroyed, Lot is afraid to stay in Zoar. He and his two daughters leave and settle in a cave in the mountains.
